tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "---INITIAL---"; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "---NEW---"; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "---COUNTS---"; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1; echo "===DELETE==="; hops fg delete --help 2>&1
hops context 2>&1 | head -30; echo "===LIST==="; hops fg list --json 2>&1 | head -40
tool_input.description: Check project context and existing feature groups

tool_input.command: hops fg create customers25bbdb --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string,name:string,balance_eur:double,updated_at:bigint" --description "Customers initial schema" --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert customers25bbdb --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25

hops fg create customers25bbdb --version 2 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string,full_name:string,balance:double,currency:string,updated_at:bigint" --online --description "Customers new schema (full reload)" --json 2>&1 | tail -25
tool_input.description: Create feature group version 2 with online store

tool_input.command: hops fg insert customers25bbdb --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv --json 2>&1 | tail -25
hops fg info customers25bbdb --version 2 --json 2>&1 | grep -iE '"online|online_enabled|name|version|currency|full_name|balance' | head -30
tool_input.description: Check v2 metadata and online flag

tool_input.command: hops fg preview customers25bbdb --version 2 --json 2>&1 | grep -ivE 'INFO:|UserWarning|compatibility|pip install|Base URL|Logged in|explore' | head -40

hops sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids FROM customers25bbdb_2" --json 2>&1 | grep -ivE 'INFO:|UserWarning|compatibility|pip install|Base URL|Logged in|explore|absl|socks5|Reading data|Finished' | head -20
tool_input.description: Count rows in v2 offline store

tool_input.command: hops --no-verify sql "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT row_id) AS distinct_ids FROM customers25bbdb_2" --json 2>&1 | grep -ivE 'INFO:|UserWarning|compatibility|pip install|Base URL|Logged in|explore|absl|socks5|Reading data|Finished' | tail -20
tool_input.description: Count rows in v2 with no-verify
